title: Vice President of Product Management at RingCentral Sees Deliverability Risks for Twilio and Believes Its AI Products Need to Prove Their Value
expert: VP Product Management, Platforms & Integrations at RingCentral (current)
verdict: A RingCentral product VP estimates Twilio's North American messaging share has fallen to roughly 60% from roughly 80% as Infobip and Sinch win on onboarding (estimate; no first-hand volume figure given).

Messaging organic growth (ex-fees): 🔴 **NA messaging share roughly 60%, down from roughly 80%** (estimate); conflicts with mgmt messaging organic +17% in 3Q26 (SB #64363). → Tenet 5 (carrier moat) ↓ {c2}
🔴 **Infobip gained a double-digit % of NA usage** (estimate) on better onboarding; first read. → Tenet 5 (carrier moat) ↓ {c9}
Voice AI minutes \u00d7 ConversationRela: 🟡 **Twilio all-in Voice AI $0.079/min vs $0.063 à la carte**; one cent matters at tens of millions of minutes; first read. → Tenet 1 (AI agent layer) ↓ {c12}
🔴 **≤20% of Voice AI customers pair LiveKit with Twilio**, but many large-volume users do (estimate); first read. → Tenet 1 (AI agent layer) ↓ {c23}
Gross profit dollar growth vs organic re: 🟢 **Multi-product customers +~26% y/y** (hearsay) vs software add-ons +25%+ in 3Q26 (SB #67665): consistent. → Tenet 3 (gross profit vs revenue) ↑ {c10}
🟡 **Verizon A2P fees +~33% passed through at zero margin** vs 3Q26 carrier fees \$53M cutting GM 90bp (SB #64364): consistent. → Tenet 3 (gross profit vs revenue) → {c7}

changes: NA messaging share **roughly 60% vs roughly 80%** earlier (expert estimate) vs mgmt messaging organic +17% in 3Q26, +18% in 2Q26 (SB #64363): **conflicting**.
Multi-product customers **+~26% y/y** (hearsay) vs software add-ons +25%+ in 3Q26 (SB #67665): consistent.
Carrier pass-through: Verizon A2P fees **+~33%** at zero margin vs 3Q26 incremental fees \$53M (2Q \$71M), GM −90bp y/y (SB #64364): consistent.
First read on Voice AI price per minute (\$0.079 all-in); no earlier expert call or stored row.
thesis_impact: Tenet 5 (carrier moat): ↓ — share roughly 60% from roughly 80% (estimate); Infobip +double-digit % of NA usage.
Tenet 1 (AI agent layer): ↓ — large voice-agent users pair LiveKit to avoid lock-in; \$0.079 vs \$0.063 per minute matters at scale.
Tenet 3 (gross profit vs revenue): → — ~33% Verizon fee rise is passed through at zero margin, diluting GM % but not gross profit dollars.
Tenet 2 (organic growth ≥10%): → — the share-loss estimate conflicts with 17% messaging organic growth (SB #64363).
